# Gameplane features

Maturity and default labels. Status as of 2026-10-14. See docs/roadmap.md.

## Servers

| Capability | Maturity | Default | Description | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Game server lifecycle | stable | on | Create, start, stop and delete game servers. | [Servers](docs/servers.md) |
| Sleep and wake | Beta | off | Hold ports while idle and wake on connect. | [Sleep](docs/sleep.md) |

## Operations

| Capability | Maturity | Default | Description | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Audit export | experimental | off | Forward audit events to syslog. | [Audit](docs/audit.md) |
| Backups | planned | n/a | Scheduled backups to object storage. | [Backups](docs/backups.md) |
